text: Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of this Agreement.
A change to a unit price takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively.
The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 30 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank Negara Indonesia, number 33750598165, in the name of Pioneer Systems Group.
Late payment accrues interest of 1% per month on the overdue amount.
A change of the payment account takes effect only after the Supplier sends a formal letter signed by a director and the Buyer verifies it by telephone on the registered number.
A request to change the account made only on an invoice or by email has no effect.
